clause.title: LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT OF {{personal.full_name}}
clause.declaration: I, {{personal.full_name}}{{frag:relation}}{{frag:age}}{{frag:occupation}}{{frag:residence}}{{frag:id}}, do hereby declare this to be my LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT, made on this {{today.day}} day of {{today.month}}, {{today.year}} at ____________________.
clause.soundmind: I declare that I am of sound mind, memory and understanding, and that I make this Will voluntarily, of my own free will, without any coercion, fraud or undue influence from any person.
clause.revocation: I hereby revoke all Wills and Codicils heretofore made by me, and declare this to be my last Will.
clause.funeral.burial: I desire and direct that my body be buried at {{frag:place}}{{frag:rites}}.
frag.burial.place.mosque: the burial ground (qabristan) of the mosque my family selects
frag.burial.place.church: the cemetery of the church my family selects
frag.burial.place.public: a public burial ground near my residence
frag.burial.place.practical: a place convenient to my family
frag.burial.rites.customs: , with the customary rites of my faith
frag.burial.rites.simple: , with a simple ceremony and without elaborate ritual
clause.funeral.cremation: I desire and direct that my body be cremated at {{frag:place}}{{frag:rites}}.{{frag:ashes}}
frag.crem.place.practical: a place convenient to my family
frag.crem.rites.customs: , with the customary rites of my faith
frag.crem.rites.simple: , with a simple ceremony and without elaborate ritual
frag.crem.ashes.immerse_at: My ashes shall be immersed at {{funeral.cremation.ashes_place}}.
frag.crem.ashes.immerse: My ashes shall be immersed as my family sees fit.
frag.crem.ashes.scatter_at: My ashes shall be scattered at {{funeral.cremation.ashes_place}}.
frag.crem.ashes.scatter: My ashes shall be scattered at a place my family selects.
frag.crem.ashes.kept: My ashes shall be kept by my family.
clause.funeral.donation: I desire and direct that my body be donated for medical education or research{{frag:institution}}. If the donation cannot be accepted for any reason, {{frag:fallback}}
frag.donation.institution.executor: , to an institution my Executor selects
frag.donation.fallback.burial: the burial directions below shall apply.
frag.donation.fallback.cremation: the cremation directions below shall apply.
frag.donation.fallback.family: my family shall decide the arrangements.
clause.funeral.family_decides: I desire that the arrangements for my remains be as my family decides.
clause.funeral.memorial: As to any memorial, I wish for {{frag:memorial}}.
frag.memorial.customs: observances according to the customs of my faith
frag.memorial.simple: a simple gathering, without formal ceremony
clause.muslim: I am aware that under the Muslim personal law applicable to me, bequests exceeding one-third of my net estate, and bequests in favour of my legal heirs, take effect only with the consent of my heirs. The bequests in this Will are intended to operate within that rule, and to the extent any bequest exceeds it, it shall take effect only so far as my heirs consent after my death; the remainder of my estate shall devolve upon my heirs in accordance with that law.
clause.general.single: This Will is executed in a single original. Any photocopy or draft shall not be treated as my Will. If any provision of this Will is held invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force.
clause.testimonium: IN WITNESS WHEREOF I, {{personal.full_name}}, have signed this Will on this {{today.day}} day of {{today.month}}, {{today.year}} at ____________________, in the joint presence of the witnesses below, who have attested it in my presence and in the presence of each other.
clause.attestation: ATTESTATION: Signed by the above-named Testator as the Testator's Last Will and Testament in our joint presence, and signed by us as witnesses in the Testator's presence and in the presence of each other, all being present at the same time. We believe the Testator to be of sound mind, memory and understanding.
clause.executor.physical: I appoint {{person:executors.physical.primary}} as the Executor of this Will.{{frag:secondary}}
frag.executor.physical.secondary: If they are unable or unwilling to act, I appoint {{person:executors.physical.secondary}} as Executor in their place.
clause.executor.digital: I appoint {{person:executors.digital.primary}} as my Digital Executor, to deal with my digital assets and online accounts as directed in this Will, and I direct my Executor to extend all necessary cooperation and authority to them.{{frag:secondary}}
frag.executor.digital.secondary: If they are unable to act, {{person:executors.digital.secondary}} shall act in their place.
clause.executor.powers: My Executor shall have full power to collect and realise my assets, to sell or convert any asset where necessary to give effect to this Will or to pay debts, to sign all documents, to engage professional assistance, to compromise claims, and to do all things necessary for the administration of my estate.{{frag:notes}}
clause.executor.compensation.none: My Executor shall receive no remuneration for acting as Executor, but shall be reimbursed all reasonable expenses incurred in the administration of my estate.
clause.executor.compensation.fixed: My Executor shall be paid {{inr:executors.compensation_amount}} from my estate for acting as Executor.
clause.executor.compensation.reasonable: My Executor shall be entitled to reasonable compensation from my estate for acting as Executor.
clause.debts.first: I direct my Executor to first pay from my estate my funeral expenses, all my just debts, taxes and liabilities, and the costs of administering my estate.
frag.tail.sell: , to be realised and the proceeds added to my residuary estate.
frag.tail.residuary: , to be added to the rest of my estate.
frag.tail.one: to {person} absolutely. If they do not survive me, this bequest shall {contingent}
frag.tail.several: to {names}, {divide}. If any of them does not survive me, their share shall {contingent}
frag.tail.contingent.children: pass to their children in equal shares.
frag.tail.contingent.group.others: be shared equally by the survivors.
frag.tail.life: I give {occupant} the right to reside in and enjoy it for their lifetime, without power of sale, and upon their death it shall pass absolutely to {remainder}.
clause.bank.account: I bequeath the balance in my {{label:item.type}} account with {{item.bank_name}}{{frag:branch}}{{frag:last4}}{{frag:joint}}{{frag:tail}}
frag.bank.account.joint: , to the extent of my share therein
clause.bank.all: I bequeath the balance standing to my credit in all my bank accounts{{frag:tail}}
clause.bank.locker: I bequeath the contents of my locker at {{bank.locker.bank}}{{frag:tail}}
clause.bank.cash: I bequeath any cash held at my residence or otherwise in my possession{{frag:tail}}
frag.re.ownership.share: my share, right, title and interest in
frag.re.action.sell: , to be sold and the net proceeds added to my residuary estate.
frag.re.action.residuary: , to be added to the rest of my estate.
frag.re.rented.continue_tenancy: The existing tenancy shall continue, with rent accruing to the new owner.
frag.re.rented.new_owner_decides: The new owner shall decide on the tenancy.
frag.re.loan: This bequest passes subject to any loan secured on the property being settled by my Executor.
clause.residuary: All the rest and residue of my estate, whether movable or immovable, present or future, including any property not specifically dealt with in this Will and any bequest that fails, I give and bequeath {{frag:primary}}. If none of the above survive me, my residuary estate shall pass to {{frag:contingent}}.
frag.residuary.primary.children: to my children, in equal shares
frag.residuary.primary.spouse_children: to my spouse and children, in equal shares
frag.residuary.contingent.legal_heirs: my legal heirs, in accordance with the law applicable to me
